style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF and cool mist #E6EBF0 for packshot and spec screens, deep navy #14304F for grid and closing framing, honest in-context surfaces for scene shots
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in deep navy #14304F, most of them left as blank slots
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral studio light with a soft front-left key and white bounce fill, real contact shadows that ground the textile; in-scene shots on 5200-5600K daylight with one consistent direction
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium utilitarian home-cleaning visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cool mist grey-blue #E6EBF0, deep navy structure #14304F and one signal-red accent #D9252B; cool neutral studio light with a soft front-left key, white bounce fill and honest contact shadows, in-scene shots holding one consistent 5200-5600K daylight direction; modern geometric sans-serif with short headline chips only; thin single-weight line icons in deep navy #14304F; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements such as blank measurement brackets, circular magnifier insets and empty proof chips; stable folded-textile geometry and consistent product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no legible brand wordmarks.
noDrift: no legible brand wordmarks or badge artwork
style.presentationRules: folded textile geometry stays squared to frame, consistent product scale across the set, no floating fabric without a contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale board #E6EBF0, dark gloss panel #101418, cool glass and brushed steel for in-use contexts
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short headline chips and small pill labels only, never dense body copy
